name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceBrowseWebViewActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when an ad response selects a timed web-browsing reward task. It loads the offer page, tracks the viewing time, and displays the result.
disableEffect: This timed ad-browsing task will stop, and its viewing rewards will no longer be granted.
